C1231.title: Austin Li’s Team Embroiled in ‘Exclusive Dealing’ and Price Floor Agreement Controversy
C1231.summary: During the 2023 Singles’ Day shopping festival, top livestreamer Austin Li and his agency Meiwan were publicly called out by JD.com’s procurement team, accused of engaging in exclusive dealing and signing price floor agreements that required brands to offer the lowest prices on Taobao platforms while restricting sales on other platforms.
